timeline.summary: Anlon Healthcare received ISIN activation from NSDL and CDSL for its equity shares of ₹2 face value following the stock split.
Anlon Healthcare completed 1:1 bonus share allotment on 27 April 2026, increasing paid-up capital to ₹106.30 Cr
Punitkumar Rasadia (Managing Director) and promoters declared no encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2025-26 on April 1, 2026.
Anlon Healthcare completed the acquisition of a 63.98% stake in Remember India Health Links Private Limited, making it a subsidiary.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹50.89 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹10.5 Cr.
Anlon Healthcare presented its Q4FY26 presentation, targeting a ~30% revenue CAGR over 3 years and capacity reach of 1,400-1,600 MTPA.
Punitkumar Rasadia, Managing Director, shared Q4/FY26 earnings conference call recording on June 3, 2026, via company website.
Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing revenue growth to ₹87.56 Cr but PAT decline to ₹8.28 Cr post-acquisition of subsidiaries via share swap.
Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing 163% YoY revenue growth to ₹87.62 Cr and 133% PAT growth to ₹8.28 Cr, driven by consolidation of recent acquisitions.
Anlon Healthcare executed share swap agreements to acquire up to 32.52% in Apiqo Organics and 43.33% in Bizotic Lifescience via preferential allotment.
Anlon Healthcare reported Q1FY27 results showing revenue growth to ₹87.62 Cr and PAT growth to ₹8.28 Cr
Anlon Healthcare board approved issuing up to 8.59 Cr shares at ₹17.85 each via preferential swap to acquire 44.94% in Apiqo and 47.41% in Bizotic for ₹153.30 Cr.
Anlon Healthcare Limited’s 13th AGM on September 05, 2026, passed 11 resolutions unanimously via e-voting, including standalone and consolidated financial statements for FY2026.
Anlon Healthcare received a BWR BBB/Stable rating on ₹23.60 Cr of bank loan facilities on September 15, 2026.
Anlon Healthcare shareholders approved the preferential share swap to acquire 44.94% of Apiqo Organics and 47.41% of Bizotic Lifescience at ₹17.85 per share on September 5, 2026.
Anlon Healthcare incorporated ANLON HEALTHCARE NIGERIA LIMITED as a 90%-owned subsidiary on September 20, 2026, to expand into the West African pharma and healthcare market.
Anlon Healthcare approved a ₹250 Cr preferential warrant issue to promoters and public investors on October 13, 2026
Anlon Healthcare received in-principle approval from NSE and BSE on October 28, 2026, for the preferential issuance of 8,05,35,651 equity shares for the share swap.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹105.61 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹13.37 Cr.
Anlon Healthcare released its Q2FY27 investor presentation showcasing consolidated revenue of ₹105.61 Cr and strategic expansion across the pharma value chain.
